title: Third Supplementary Supply and Budget Adjustments (FY 2020) Bill
what_it_is: Third Supplementary Supply and Budget Adjustments (FY 2020) Bill

sections.label: Third Supplementary Estimates approval
sections.summary: The House approved additional sums in the Third Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for 1 April 2020 to 31 March 2021, in Paper Cmd No 3 of 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The additional sums have been approved by the House in the Third Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the financial year 1 April 2020 to 31 March 2021 as contained in Paper Cmd No 3 of 2020.
